name: GST Collections
description: Gross GST collections track total goods-and-services tax revenue each month. In September 2026 net collections after refunds were ₹1.77 lakh crore, up 18.1% year-on-year.
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, on the 1st, for the previous month.

chart.title: GST revenue grew 14.7% from a year earlier

chart.source: Ministry of Finance data via Business Today, 1 Oct 2026
